infobox.usage: Unlocks the hideout below the cinema stairs on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Backup hideout key (Hideout) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Informant's second hideout.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Missing Informant

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: In a sports bag which is located in an electrical operation room behind the small cinema. Guaranteed spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Hideout below the cinema stairs at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Wooden crate
- 1x Sport bag
- 1x Toolbox
- Loose loot (Electronics, Valuables)
